WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS trn ON trn.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = trn.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
),
group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM group_counts
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT gc.tradekind, gc.record_count,
         1.0 * gc.record_count / (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM group_counts) AS share
  FROM group_counts AS gc
  CROSS JOIN group_avg AS ga
  WHERE gc.record_count > ga.avg_count
)
SELECT SUM(record_count), AVG(share), AVG(record_count - (SELECT avg_count FROM group_avg))
FROM filtered
